column1: # Shared hint → PRIMARY routing rules for master-route.{sh,ps1} and case-init.{sh,ps1}.
# Single source of truth: edit here only; bash (grep -Ei) and pwsh (-match, case-insensitive) read the same file.
# Format: PRIMARY<TAB>REASON<TAB>REGEX  — first matching line wins; no match → skills/triage/ (default).
# Priority: android > js (incl. Electron/ASAR) > packaged runtime → triage first > binary > default triage
# Keep regex to the common subset of GNU ERE and .NET (alternation, \b, \s, ?, escaped dots). No REA tool-name routing.
